subject: Architecture
title: Petra: A City Carved from Cliffs
description: A quick win: understand Petra: A City Carved from Cliffs.

hook.text: The Nabataeans didn't build Petra — they carved it directly into red sandstone cliffs.

buildup.text: The Treasury facade is 130 feet tall, sculpted from the living rock with hand chisels.

discovery.text: Petra controlled desert trade routes. Water channels carved into rock kept the city alive.

twist.text: The elaborate facades are just entrances. Behind them are simple, square rooms.

climax.text: Earthquakes and shifting trade routes killed Petra. It lay forgotten for 600 years.

punchline.text: They carved a city from a mountain. The desert buried it anyway.

quiz.question: What is behind Petra's elaborate Treasury facade?
options: A vast treasure vault filled with gold
Simple, square rooms carved into the rock
An elaborate palace with multiple levels
